id: title:andrewm4894:raise inbox ranking dag run pod memory to 16gi

review.posthog_relevance: Changes resource requests and limits for the Dagster Kubernetes deployment, potentially preventing OOMKilled failures for the inbox report model DAG.
review.reason: Adds a DAGster Kubernetes resource configuration block, requesting 8Gi and limiting to 16Gi memory for the container. This could prevent OOMKilled failures for the inbox report model DAG, allowing it to complete despite the large memory footprint of the embeddings and labels assets.
